Name: Crystalarium Enhancement(EN)(CN)
Author: 9642ASD
Description:
[center][size=6][b]复制机 / Duplicator[/b][/size]
[size=4]把任何东西放进去，复制一份一模一样的出来。[/size][/center]

[line]

[b]模组功能[/b]

新增一台使用[b]原版宝石复制机贴图[/b]的「复制机」。把物品放进去，等待一段时间，就能收获一份完全相同的复制品。

[list]
[*][b]复制任意物品[/b] —— 普通物品、模组物品都可以。[/*]
[*][b]保留星级[/b] —— 铱星进，铱星出；银星、金星同理。[/*]
[*][b]保留颜色与价格[/b] —— 复制品与原件一致。[/*]
[*][b]自动连续复制[/b] —— 收取后机器会自动开始下一份，原件不会被消耗。[/*]
[*][b]配方自动解锁[/b] —— 不需要好感或剧情，开档即可制作。[/*]
[*][b]复制时间可调[/b] —— GMCM 内可选 1 小时 / 12 小时 / 24 小时 / 3 天 / 1 周。[/*]
[*][b]中英双语[/b] —— 根据游戏语言自动显示中文或英文。[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]制作配方[/b]

[b]166 个铱锭 + 16 个宝石复制机[/b]

配方在进入存档时自动学会，制作菜单里直接可见。

[line]

[b]复制时间[/b]

默认 [b]3 天[/b]，可在 [b]设置 → 模组选项 → Duplicator → 复制时间[/b] 中修改：

[list]
[*]1 小时（60 机器分钟）[/*]
[*]12 小时（720）[/*]
[*]24 小时（1440）[/*]
[*]3 天（3600，默认）[/*]
[*]1 周（8400）[/*]
[/list]修改只影响之后放入的物品；已经开始复制的机器会保留当前计时。

[line]

[b]前置要求[/b]

[list]
[*]星露谷物语 [b]1.6.x[/b]（基于 1.6.15 编译测试）[/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.0.0[/b] 或更高[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] —— [i]可选[/i]，仅用于游戏内设置菜单[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]安装方法[/b]

1. 安装 SMAPI。
2. 把 [b]Duplicator[/b] 文件夹解压到 Mods 目录。
3. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。

[line]

[b]使用方法[/b]

1. 打开制作菜单，制作「复制机」。
2. 放在农场或室内。
3. 手持任意物品，对着机器按使用键放入。
4. 等待设定时间后，对着机器按使用键收取。
5. 收取后机器会自动开始复制下一份。

[line]

[b]配置文件[/b]

也可以直接编辑 [b]Mods/Duplicator/config.json[/b]：

[code]{
  "CopyTime": "3 days"
}[/code]可选值：`1 hour` / `12 hours` / `24 hours` / `3 days` / `1 week`

[line]

[b]说明与兼容性[/b]

[list]
[*]机器通过原版 [b]Data/Machines[/b] 的 `DROP_IN_ID` + `CopyQuality` / `CopyColor` / `CopyPrice` 规则实现，因此大多数模组物品都能正常复制。[/*]
[*]工具、武器不是普通 Object 物品，能否放入取决于游戏自身的机器逻辑。[/*]
[*]没有已知冲突；不修改原版物品，只新增一台机器和一个配方。[/*]
[*]可以安全加入已有存档，也可以随时移除。[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]制作名单[/b]

[list]

[*][b]deepseekV4.1[/b] —— AI 开发助手[/*]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] —— SMAPI[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu 团队[/b] —— 配置菜单[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]更新日志[/b]

[b]1.0.0[/b]
[list]

[/list][center][size=6][b]Duplicator[/b][/size]
[size=4]Put anything in. Get an exact copy out.[/size][/center]

[line]

[b]What this mod does[/b]

Adds a **Duplicator** machine that uses the vanilla **Crystalarium** art. Insert an item, wait for the configured time, and collect an exact copy.

[list]
[*][b]Duplicates any item[/b] — vanilla and modded objects alike.[/*]
[*][b]Keeps quality[/b] — iridium in, iridium out; silver and gold work the same way.[/*]
[*][b]Keeps color and price[/b] — the copy matches the original.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic repeat[/b] — after collecting, it starts the next copy; the source item is never consumed.[/*]
[*][b]Recipe auto-unlocked[/b] — no friendship or story progress required.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable copy time[/b] — 1 hour / 12 hours / 24 hours / 3 days / 1 week in GMCM.[/*]
[*][b]English & Chinese[/b] — the display language follows your game language automatically.[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]Crafting recipe[/b]

**166 Iridium Bars + 16 Crystalariums**

The recipe is learned automatically when a save is loaded and appears directly in the crafting menu.

[line]

[b]Copy time[/b]

Default: **3 days**. Change it in **Settings → Mod Options → Duplicator → Copy time**:

[list]
[*]1 hour (60 machine minutes)[/*]
[*]12 hours (720)[/*]
[*]24 hours (1440)[/*]
[*]3 days (3600, default)[/*]
[*]1 week (8400)[/*]
[/list]Changing the setting only affects items inserted afterwards; machines already processing keep their current timer.

[line]

[b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.x[/b] (built and tested against 1.6.15)[/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.0.0[/b] or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — [i]optional[/i], only for the in-game settings menu[/*]
[/list][line]

[b]Installation[/b]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Extract the [b]Duplicator[/b] folder into your Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[line]

[b]Usage[/b]

1. Open the crafting menu and craft the Duplicator.
2. Place it on the farm or indoors.
3. Hold any item and press the use key on the machine to insert it.
4. Wait for the configured time, then press the use key to collect the copy.
5. The machine automatically starts the next copy.

[line]

[b]Configuration[/b]

Or edit [b]Mods/Duplicator/config.json[/b]:

[code]{
  "CopyTime": "3 days"
}[/code]Allowed values: `1 hour` / `12 hours` / `24 hours` / `3 days` / `1 week`

[line]

[b]Notes and compatibility[/b]

[list]
[*]The machine is data-driven through vanilla [b]Data/Machines[/b] using `DROP_IN_ID` + `CopyQuality` / `CopyColor` / `CopyPrice`, so most modded objects work.[/*]
[*]Tools and weapons are not normal Object items; whether they can be inserted depends on the game's machine logic.[/*]
[*]No known conflicts. It only adds one machine and one recipe; no vanilla items are modified.[/*]
[*]Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.[/*]
[/list][line]
